recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce Alert.note or add a parallel note element for FHIR-3877; future changes to Flag.code binding, cardinality, or display guidance should be handled under a new applied/published tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-3877 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Patient Care change request raised against DSTU1 Alert/Flag. It asked to change Alert.note from string to CodeableConcept so alert text and coded alert pick-list values could both be represented.

additional_context: Flag is active in source/fhir.ini and Alert is recorded as having become Flag. Current source/flag/structuredefinition-Flag.xml defines Flag.code as 1..1 CodeableConcept with coded/textual display semantics, CodeableConcept.text guidance, and an example binding. Related Published issues FHIR-3523, FHIR-3292, FHIR-8560, and FHIR-11202 reinforce the same current model rather than contradicting it.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The authoritative current source already satisfies the seed, and searches found no stale current Alert.note or Flag.note element requiring conversion.
